diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepeat ineffective actions without observable progress, especially clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: A progress-sensitive repetition guard interrupts action loops and forces evidence gathering or a changed tactic. Expected cost: modest state-tracking and reasoning overhead, with some risk of abandoning repetitions that would eventually succeed.
policy_text: Track recent action–target–state triples. Before repeating one without observable progress, require a new hypothesis or changed parameter. After two ineffective repetitions, stop that tactic and choose a materially different action, inspect new evidence, or report the blocker.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated operations have a net candidate/bad excess of 1,261, equal to 11.31% of the profile's 11,146 signed total. Major excess actions include click +639, no-op +356, and scroll +277.
Base/good runs contain 224 repeated operations in magnitude; candidate/bad runs therefore show 6.63× as many and an excess of 1,261.
